name: Queek Headtaker
canonNotes: Warlord of Clan Mors and the Skaven's most feared champion, famed for collecting the heads of his enemies on a trophy rack.
Fights Belegar's Dwarfs and Skarsnik's Goblins for Karak Eight Peaks.
voiceNotes: Arrogant, twitchy and boastful; Skaven speech tics (yes-yes), talks of heads.
Respects only strength; treachery is natural to him.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
